objective: Evaluate the already sealed SuperVINS stage-4 trajectory once against the official EuRoC MH_01_easy state ground truth using deterministic timestamp association, fixed-scale SE(3) alignment, translation APE, and one-second positional-delta RPE. This stage performs no model, ROS, publisher, trajectory generation, loop fusion, or system comparison.

source_run.sequence: official EuRoC MH_01_easy; not README-recommended V2_01

trajectory.format: TUM text: timestamp_s tx ty tz qx qy qz qw

official_ground_truth.provenance: Official EuRoC MH_01_easy nonlinear least-squares batch solution over Leica position and IMU measurements including time-offset estimation; orientation is observed by the IMU.

official_imu0_sensor.role: Confirms that the estimator IMU/body pose and the official EuRoC body frame coincide.

official_cam0_timestamps.role: Authoritative recovery of the source camera nanosecond timestamp for every fixed-six-decimal trajectory row before an exact integer join to GT.

official_ground_truth.frame_contract: The GT sensor T_BS is exactly identity, so p_RS_R is evaluated as the body position. The SuperVINS output is world_T_body. No camera extrinsic is composed for this body-to-body evaluation.

association_contract.timestamp_parser: Parse the sealed fixed-six-decimal trajectory text with Decimal only to compare it with official camera timestamps. Never treat Decimal(timestamp_text)*1e9 as restoration of the original ROS/camera nanoseconds: all 1810 rows have lost the source sub-microsecond value. The signed text-ns minus source-camera-ns difference is -456 ns for 1086 rows and +544 ns for 724 rows; the latter 724 formatted values cross upward to the next microsecond.
association_contract.policy: First bind every trajectory row to one unique official cam0/data.csv row. The independently nearest camera timestamp within 1000 ns must equal the frozen source suffix cam0 row index 63 + 2*trajectory_row_index. Recover the source nanoseconds exclusively from that camera CSV row. Then join the recovered integer camera timestamp to an exactly identical integer timestamp in official GT. No nearest-GT association, GT interpolation, or extrapolation is allowed. A camera timestamp absent from GT is excluded only when it is after the official GT interval, with reason EXCLUDED_OUTSIDE_GT_COVERAGE; an in-range missing exact GT timestamp is a hard failure.

expected_estimator_output_camera_rows.meaning: All 10 Hz odd-index camera rows at which the stage-4 estimator could emit its every-second-image trajectory output.

generation_support.tail_11_interpretation: The final 11 generated rows are outside official GT time coverage; they are not generation failures and are excluded from accuracy statistics.

alignment_contract.method: Kabsch/Umeyama fixed-scale rigid SE(3) alignment of all 1799 associated estimate body positions to their GT body positions
alignment_contract.rank_gate: Centered source positions, centered target positions, and cross-covariance must each have numerical rank >=2 under the pinned NumPy matrix-rank tolerance; rank-0 and rank-1 inputs are hard failures.
alignment_contract.implementation_crosscheck: The fresh evaluator implementation must agree with the frozen scripts/trajectory_eval_core.py align_se3_positions output to <=1e-12 m max absolute coordinate difference on the same associated positions.

secondary_sim3_scale_diagnostic.method: Proper Umeyama Sim(3) alignment on the exact same 1799 associated body-position pairs

metric_contract.primary_metric: fixed-scale SE(3)-aligned translation APE in metres
metric_contract.ape_definition: Euclidean norm of aligned estimate position minus matched GT position at each of 1799 associated timestamps.
metric_contract.rpe_definition: After the same global fixed-scale SE(3) alignment, Euclidean norm of the difference between estimate and GT global-frame positional deltas over a nominal one-second interval.

statistical_contract.reason: There is one deterministic run and its timestamp-wise residuals are serially correlated. The bundle is descriptive only.

bundle_schema.artifact_manifest_algorithm: SHA-256 over each completed bundle file's exact bytes. Then compute bundle_content_tree_sha256 over compact canonical JSON (sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon) of the sorted list [{path,sha256,size_bytes}]. The manifest excludes itself and is then pinned by terminal run_result.json.

serialization.json: UTF-8, sort_keys=true, indent=2, ensure_ascii=false, exactly one trailing LF
serialization.csv: UTF-8, frozen header order, source-row order, LF line endings, floating values serialized with Python format .17g
serialization.svg: UTF-8 deterministic standard-library text generator; no timestamps, external processes, fonts, matplotlib, or network assets

analysis_bundle_contract.figures: Deterministic vector SVG generated by the pinned evaluator using Python standard-library text generation only, with no matplotlib or external figure process. The palette is colour-blind-safe. No error bars are shown because this is one deterministic trajectory, not repeated independent runs.

execution_contract.seal_contract: Final freeze, execution lock, root authority, start claim, all analysis bundle files, and terminal run_result must each be mode 0444 with nlink=1. Runner and tests are byte-identity pinned by the execution lock.

failure_closeout: After the fresh namespace or start claim exists, any exception or caught SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP must produce one exclusive terminal FAIL result with input pins, completed artifact identities, and error details. SIGKILL cannot be guaranteed. No retry is allowed.
postcondition: A PASS supports only that the one pinned sealed SuperVINS trajectory has the reported descriptive fixed-scale SE(3)-aligned translation APE and one-second positional-delta RPE on the official MH_01_easy GT overlap. It does not establish V2_01 performance, statistical significance, generalization, underwater performance, or superiority over AQUA-FE or any other system.
